sentences.full: We should have good manners in public places.
sentences.cn: 我們在公共場所應該有禮貌。

sentences.full: In the restaurant, we should eat quietly.
sentences.cn: 在餐廳裡，我們應該安靜地進食。

sentences.full: We shouldn’t make a mess at the table because it is very rude.
sentences.cn: 我們不應該把餐桌弄得一團糟，因為這樣很沒有禮貌。

sentences.full: In the cinema, we should wait patiently in the queue for tickets and snacks.
sentences.cn: 在電影院裡，我們應該耐心排隊購買戲票和小食。

sentences.full: We shouldn’t talk loudly during the film. Also, we shouldn’t use our phones because the light will disturb others.
sentences.cn: 我們不應該在電影播放期間大聲說話。此外，我們也不應該使用手機，因為手機的光線會打擾其他人。
